title: Differentials of the universal first order thickening of an algebraic space morphism restrict to the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The algebraic-spaces form of the restriction statement for differentials of the universal first order thickening. The proof works through an etale chart to reduce to the schemes statement, using that both the universal thickening and the sheaf of differentials are compatible with etale localisation, and then transports the isomorphism back along the chart. The compatibility of the two constructions with etale localisation is what the argument turns on. Retained author proof at lines 3336-3347 statement, proof 3349-3375.
